comparisons.what: Compare Bonferroni correction and the Benjamini-Hochberg procedure (against no correction) in false discoveries and in power across m and pi1.

constraints: Use one-sided z-tests in which each real effect shifts the test statistic by 2.5.
When pi1 = 0 there are no real effects, so power is undefined; report only the chance of any false discovery.
One Python script using numpy (and scipy where it helps), with matplotlib (Agg backend).
Two or three figures that answer the question directly, each with the reference or theory value drawn.
A short paper of at most 4 pages.
Cite only sources actually found and read; if a reference cannot be confirmed, say so rather than citing it.
CPU only; under 60 seconds of runtime.
Fixed random seeds where the run is random, stated in the paper.
Report every number with its uncertainty (for a deterministic result, its numerical error), and say when a result is only a check of the code.
